v.title: Vs a passive 3-bet

src.quote: Vs a passive rec: fold a lot. That's the exploit: they under-3-bet, so overfold. Never 4-bet bluff them, in any position.

src.section: 2. Bet sizing: small or big, never in between
src.quote: In-between is the worst of both: better hands call and your targets fold.

v.title: Multiway c-bets

src.quote: A big multiway c-bet is "too strong," so overfold, even top pair. A small multiway c-bet is too weak, so attack it with low-equity draws and backdoors.

v.title: Multiway donks

src.quote: A multiway donk is "much, much stronger" than a heads-up donk.

v.title: Tight configs have little air
